name: Renesandro
tagline: Bulk-generate and test static and video ad creatives with AI.
description: Renesandro is a B2B platform that mass-generates static and video ad creatives for performance marketing teams — up to 12 reference images and 12 prompts per task, yielding 50+ variations per batch on top of models like Veo, Sora, Kling, and Flux. It layers in AI avatars, lip-sync, localization, and bulk layer-based editing, sold as a subscription with unlimited monthly generations.
insight: Bootstrapped solo by Ukrainian founder Stanislav Kravets; launched Oct 2023 with revenue covering 70%+ of expenses by early 2025.

modelSupport.notes: Generates ad creatives over leading video and image models.

edge: Sells unlimited-generation subscriptions tuned for bulk creative testing — 50+ ad variations per batch — where most peers meter by credits.
pros: Bulk static and video ad generation

references.title: How the Ukrainian startup Renesandro AI was created
